headline: PTC India Financial Services submits SEBI depository compliance certificate
summary: PTC India Financial Services Limited has submitted a regulatory certificate as required under the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. This is a routine periodic filing submitted to the stock exchanges. It has no immediate financial impact on the company's business operations or earnings. Retail investors have no action required from this routine disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine paperwork with zero impact on stock price
